block.description: No configuration is needed for this provider.

from_cidrs.description: A list containing the CIDR range(s) from which to search for available CIDR ranges. Changing this value after creation **HAS NO EFFECT**. This allows the `result` CIDR to remain stable when it is used to find a range to create a network/subnet. If you would like to conditionally update this resource, use the `keepers` field.

id.description: CIDR Identifier. The value will be identical to the `result` field.

keepers.description: Arbitrary map of values that, when changed, will trigger re-creation of resource. This field works the same as the `keepers` field in the [`Random` provider](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/random/latest/docs#resource-keepers).

mask.description: Desired mask (network/subnet size) to find that is available. Changing this value after creation **HAS NO EFFECT**. This allows the `result` CIDR to remain stable when it is used to find a range to create a network/subnet. If you would like to conditionally update this resource, use the `keepers` field.

result.description: The available CIDR that was found.

used_cidrs.description: A list containing the CIDR ranges that are already used within the `from_cidrs` block(s) which should be avoided to prevent overlaps and/or collisions. Changing this value after creation **HAS NO EFFECT**. This allows the `result` CIDR to remain stable when it is used to find a range to create a network/subnet. If you would like to conditionally update this resource, use the `keepers` field.

block.description: Given CIDR range(s) to search over (ex. a Network) and a list of already used CIDR ranges (ex. a list of subnets) find an unused, non-conflicting CIDR range of specified size.
